'''Hul Rapuung''' was the brother of [[Vua Rapuung]] and a [[Warrior caste|Warrior]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. He was assigned to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] when the Yuuzhan Vong took the moon. While there, he ran into his brother, but did not seem to treat him with the usual contempt the high-caste Yuuzhan Vong held the [[Shamed Ones]] in. When [[Mezhan Kwaad]] refused to answer Vua's questions, and when [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tsaak Vootuh]] refused to intercede, Hul challenged Kwaad, asking if any doubted the gods favor of Vua. After Kwaad revealed that she had infected Vua with a virus and was killed, Hul told Vua that he was a warrior again and should kill [[Anakin Solo]]. Vua refused and stunned Hul with an [[amphistaff]] and went on to kill many Yuuzhan Vong warriors before being killed. In some legends of the [[Jeedai heresy|''Jeedai'' heresy]], Hul fought side by side with the redeemed Vua, while in others, it was he, not Mezhan Kwaad, who killed Vua.<ref name="NJO" />
